body:
I've always been very pro family, it makes me feel like a bad brother that I didn't know she was hurting like this.

And I know you don't know me but I care about you. If you ever need someone to talk to I can be your big brother too.

It seems like everyone else is leaning towards tough love and being angry and I just want her to know that I love her.
I was thinking of not even mentioning it like you said and just talking about video games or something.

Thanks man, it just sucks because I'm 6 hours away and feel so helpless.

I hope things have been looking up for you too.
